needed.evidence: The left side of the road is a continuous row of parked cars with no separate paved path for pedestrians.
needed.suggestion: Construct a 1.5 m wide concrete footway on the left side, funded by a developer contribution from the adjacent residential plots.

needed.evidence: The right side of the road is an unpaved dirt shoulder with no defined pedestrian path.
needed.suggestion: Install a 1.5 m wide asphalt footway on the right side, using the existing verge width to provide a safe walking surface.
